attributes.title: SGNA 54th Annual Course
attributes.organizer: Society of Gastroenterology Nurses and Associates
attributes.summary:
SGNA's 54th Annual Course for gastroenterology and endoscopy nurses takes place May 22 to 24, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency New Orleans.

Registration is open. The full course costs members $585 through April 1, 2027, and $665 after; non-members pay $805, then $885. One day is $295 for members and $405 for non-members, and students working toward initial licensure pay $140. The SGNA room rate at the Hyatt Regency is $259 per night, and refunds (less $150) are available for cancellations received by April 9, 2027.

SGNA is accredited by ANCC as a provider of nursing continuing professional development and says attendees earn contact hours, but the number of hours is not published yet.
